text: V1 is a RAS/MAPK paper-level transformer. Tokens are papers, not words. Time is causal. human_genetics and resistance are held out of inputs and of the loss. The probe label is prior_genetic_evidence: an earlier paper on the same gene timeline was tagged human_genetics. Compare a linear probe on frozen text embeddings versus contextual hidden states on years >= 2021. Then ablate that direction and see whether next-clinical prediction moves more when prior genetics is in context.
Claimed held-out genetics probe and ablation.
Claimed ingest, claims, and encoder.
Claimed the causal paper transformer and trainer.

T1 src/ingest/pubmed.py: parse_europepmc_result(item)->dict keys pmid:str, date:YYYY-MM-DD, year:int, title, abstract, journal, mesh:list[str], pub_types:list[str]; fetch_papers(per_year=None)->list[dict] deduped by pmid (default config.PER_YEAR); main() writes config.PAPERS_PATH jsonl. Run: python -m src.ingest.pubmed. T2 src/claims/extract.py: enrich_paper(paper)->copy plus genes, drugs, diseases (schema vocabulary order), evidence_tags, relations. relations are {head, rel, tail} with rel in inhibits|activates|associated_with|resistant_to. inhibits and resistant_to: head=drug, tail=gene. activates: one pair, head=earlier GENES symbol, tail=later. associated_with: head=gene, tail=disease. main() reads PAPERS_PATH and writes ENRICHED_PATH. Run: python -m src.claims.extract. T3 src/encode/encoder.py: encode_texts(texts, prefer_neural=True)->float32 [N, 768] L2-normalized; module LAST_ENCODER. sentence-transformers is not imported at module import; it is imported only inside encode_texts when prefer_neural is True. The package is not installed, so that path catches the failure and falls back without raising. LAST_ENCODER stays config.HASH_ENCODER_NAME (hash768-v1) unless the neural model actually loads, then config.ENCODER_NAME (pritamdeka/S-PubMedBert-MS-MARCO). main() encodes schema.paper_text (title+abstract) with prefer_neural=True, writes EMBEDDINGS_PATH float32 npy and EMBEDDING_META_PATH {encoder, n}. Row i matches enriched jsonl line i. Run: python -m src.encode.encoder. Model/probe: keep human_genetics, resistance, and evidence_tags off training inputs and the loss; they remain on the enriched records so the probe can build prior_genetic_evidence from earlier papers on the same gene timeline. genes/drugs/diseases are canonical vocab strings for multi_hot.

PaperTransformer.clinical_head is the Linear d_model->1 clinical projection; forward squeezes it to logits_clinical [B,T]. Checkpoint dict keys: state_dict, d_model, n_layers, n_heads, top_k (CPU state_dict at config.CHECKPOINT_PATH). build_windows items: pmid, year, date, text (float tensor 768), genes, drugs, diseases, clinical (1.0 if "clinical" in evidence_tags else 0.0), evidence_tags. collate_windows ignores evidence_tags; they stay out of the batch, along with every other FORBIDDEN_BATCH_KEYS entry. Forward also returns hidden [B,T,D], attn_index [B,H,T,K] (-1 unused), attn_weight [B,H,T,K] (0 unused), logits_genes, logits_drugs.

Report keys: encoder, n_papers, n_test_positions, prior_genetics_auroc_frozen, prior_genetics_auroc_contextual, prior_genetics_auroc_lift, resistance_auroc_contextual, ablation_delta_clinical_bce_genetics_context, ablation_delta_clinical_bce_no_genetics_context, selective_ablation, head_genetics_attention, notes. evidence_tags are read from build_windows window dicts, not from the training batch. Ablation uses batch y_clinical at the current position (collate already stores the next paper's clinical flag).

Integrated and ran the pipeline. 1958 Europe PMC papers, PubMedBERT embeddings, 8 epochs, loss 1.06 to 0.78. Held-out prior-genetics AUROC frozen 0.507 contextual 0.518. Ablation deltas 0.0024 vs 0.0017. No genetics circuit yet.

Claim-centered graph retrieval started. Equal budget 20. Routes: same_gene, text_similarity, citation, experimental, shared_references, combination. Explorer shell is explorer/shell.html. Direct-test yield waits on judgments.

Audited the 20-claim retrieval judgments without changing frozen lists. Text similarity remains ahead of the combination. PMID 21850009 is disputed, not a settled mistake. A fixed compatibility ranker is development evidence only.

Ranker minus text reconciles: the ALK, C016, and C035 swings net to -3, and the other claims net to +6. Provenance-aware selection, with the compatibility score frozen, matches the ranker at 50 tests. Six of the seven uncovered claims have no eligible test in the searched set. C068 retrieval missed PMID 36156071.

PMID 36156071 matched the C068 queries and the screen, and was below the page cap. Requiring Atg5 recovers it at screened rank 1, as a regression check. On 11 fresh claims in two families the revised query adds no claim with an eligible direct test. Text has one, on C045.

Candidate depth on the fixed text query: 40, 200, and 1000 hits each return twenty papers. Fresh claims with an eligible direct test stay 1 of 11 at every depth. Direct tests rise from 1 to 3 to 11, all on C045. PMID 36156071 is not in the first 1000. The twenty-from-40 setup is the one to keep.

Retrieval tuning is paused. The default is up to twenty papers from the first 40 text-query hits. The same eleven held-out families, reused for the depth comparison, gained evidence density on C045 only. An evidence map of C024, C033, and C015 asks whether recorded conditions make disagreements intelligible. Ras dose and ALK selection do. Adult BRAF node results still differ.

The three-case map no longer treats conditions as having explained two disagreements. C024 keeps Ras activity and cooperating alterations as separate variables. C033 rates stay on their own denominators: 2/131, 4/1000 in EGFR-wild-type tumors, and 12/6637 only if that is the screened denominator. C015 nonsignificance, including P=.167 in PMID 23062653, is not an opposite direction.

Evidence-map phase closed. The 27-result map is the worked specification: a result tied to a question, with population, comparator, conditions, estimate, and uncertainty. C024 shows different conditions with different outcomes. C033 shows similar-looking fractions estimating different quantities. C015 shows different statistical conclusions with estimates that can still be compatible. Across three exploratory cases, explicit result records exposed distinctions that paper-level agreement labels had obscured. The map separates experimental conditions, quantities being estimated, and statistical uncertainty. It does not yet establish causal explanations, generalization, or predictive value.
Paper transformer v2: config_v2, dataset_v2, transformer_v2, train_v2. New files only. Spec docs/specs/2026-09-29-model-v2-design.md.
Probe v2 with bootstrap lift and the pre-registered decision rule. New files only.

Transformer v2 closed under its pre-registered rule: not fruitful. Attention test loss 0.9547 vs mean 0.9474 (seed std 0.0033), so attention does not help next-paper prediction. Genetics probe lift 0.119 [0.069, 0.166] passed. Post hoc: attention beats the mean mixer on the probe by 0.048 [0.025, 0.069]; exploratory, same test years. Run 1 discarded: untrained post-2018 year embeddings (also in v1) and a random-init probe with ~0.08 AUROC spread.

2026 confirmation of the v2 attention-vs-mean genetics readout: not confirmed. 80 new abstracts, 206 test positions (108 positive). Attention minus mean 0.044 [-0.007, 0.098]. An untrained probe on mean earlier text scored 0.671, above attention at 0.601. v2 closed; next is plan B, result-level records.

Result-record extraction spike: not feasible as set up. Sonnet extractor, blind: numeric recall 0.92, population same 0.93, comparator 0.52, quantity estimated 0.41 (bar 0.80). Rule on extracted fields: C024 conditions (correct), C033 conditions (ref estimand), C015 tie (ref certainty). Numbers and populations extract; the exact comparison and denominator do not. Opus extractor was stopped by a safety classifier and not rerun.

Correction to the spike note: the Opus extraction did complete and is now scored. Final, one blind judge for both: Sonnet recall 0.92, population 0.93, comparator 0.59, quantity 0.48; Opus 0.86, 0.85, 0.41, 0.48. Rule misses C033 and C015 for both, and C024 for Opus. Extractors agree on direction 0.96 and significance 1.00, but on condition departure 0.70 and quantity match 0.48. Spike closed: not feasible as set up.
